senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גדל)greatness, distinction, dignity, wealth, high position, office.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 59a:4">Gitt. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>תורה וג׳ במקום א׳</he> learning and high office combined in one person.
<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:9">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>בג׳ מתחילין מן הגדול וכ׳</he> for distinction the superior is first mentioned, for degradation the inferior.
<cite ref="Eruvin 13b:13">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מחזר על הג׳</he> hunting for office.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:24">Ib. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>עולה לג׳</he> will rise to distinction.
Y. Ter. V, 43ᶜ top למשחה לג׳ וכ׳ ‘for ointment’ (Num. XVIII, 11) means for installation in office, for unguent, and for lighting.
<cite ref="Megillah 31a:12">Meg. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּדוּלָּתוֹ של הקב״ה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גבורתו</he>) a description of the greatness of the Lord.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> end <he>הלב ששמח בגדוּלַּת אחיו וכ׳</he> the heart (of Aaron) which rejoiced over a brother’s distinction shall wear the Urim &c.; a. fr.
